detail.publication_target: methods note: structural positivity of dressed Bloch Hessians
detail.reuse_scope: Any matched-cumulant fluctuation operator with a real scalar order parameter; replaces Gershgorin row bounds by an exact structural floor.
detail.statement_one_line: The matched second-cumulant off-diagonal transfer operator is `W = λ′(P²−2I·Id)`, `P=Σ A_u S_u` self-adjoint ⇒ `D+W = D₀+λ′P² ≥ D₀ > 0` unconditionally; n-free, pattern-free spectral floor `−2λ′I/r̂`.
